answer: To resist Sybils an agent economy assigns every identity an exclusive sealed chamber with one live raven whose feather plume is lit by a calibrated UV lamp. Challenges demand a signed spectrum of the evolving pigment chemistry from that chamber’s private spectrometer. Optical coupling and the bird’s unique response make the signal non-shareable; multiplexed chambers produce spectral collisions the verifier rejects. Independent chambers, ravens and isolation infrastructure impose logistics costs that grow super-linearly.
